name: TCTHP
summary: TCTHP is a designer drug from the arylcyclohexylamine family, which has dissociative-like effects in animal studies. It is an analogue of tenocyclidine where the piperidine ring has been replaced by an unsaturated 1,2,3,6-tetrahydropyridine ring. Similarly to tenocyclidine itself and other related compounds such as ketamine and phencyclidine, TCTHP acts as an NMDA antagonist.
